name: accountsos
description: AI-native accounting across 26 countries: ask your live ledger about transactions, VAT, deadlines, expenses and invoices in plain English. The bundled tax skills are UK-only for now (corporation tax, VAT, MTD, BADR, capital allowances, verified for the 2026/27 tax year). The UK is the proof jurisdiction with live HMRC MTD VAT filing, and the other 25 countries run as jurisdiction playbooks in the product.
author: Thrive Venture Labs
